response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with a strong generalist background across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure work, and recent (since April 2025) exposure to MCP tooling and agentic workflow infrastructure. However, he lacks the core requirement of 8+ years building AI-driven solutions — his AI/agentic experience spans only about a year, there is no mention of Python, vector databases, RAG architectures, or evaluation/observability pipelines for AI systems, and no evidence of leading technical discovery sessions with enterprise stakeholders. The gap between his generalist software craftsman profile and the deep, specialized GenAI/cloud requirements of this Staff FDE role is significant.
strengths: 15+ years of senior/staff-level software engineering experience across diverse domains and languages
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic workflow infrastructure at re:cinq
Strong communicator with a track record of teaching, mentoring, and public speaking (workshops, conference talks)
concerns: No demonstrated 8+ years of AI-driven solution development; core AI/GenAI experience is under two years
No mention of Python, vector databases, or RAG architectures — all explicitly required key technologies
No evidence of leading customer-facing technical discovery sessions or building data pipelines/evaluation frameworks for AI systems

key_factors.factor: Missing Python and limited depth in required AI tech stack
Strong general engineering seniority and recent agentic/MCP exposure
